title: NBA: Maxey scores 38 to lead Sixers 'fighters' to another comeback win
summary: Tyrese Maxey scored 38 points to spark the Philadelphia 76ers in a fightback 109-104 victory at Charlotte on Saturday while LeBron James and Joel Embiid were rested with injuries.
